description:
Crab Shack

Requires MagicLib

Requires GraphicsLib

Additional content when enabled with the following mods :

Secrets of the Frontier

Second in Command

Nexerelin

YE OLDE DOWNLOAD LINK

(also supports Lunalib's version checker)

An unserious mod that contains whatever I happened to think was funny at the moment. Has quests, ships with weird mechanics, lots of dialog, special items, boss fights, exploration content, fishing, etc...

A non-exhaustive list of previews below

Exploration stuff

Spoiler
Fall into the trap of a deadly Houndslaught, gain an unlikely ally after defeating a colony of giant alien spiders, use metamorphic fluid to duplicate said ally, respond to an ancient distress signal to aid in combat against an abyssal threat, or accidentally install adware onto your Tripad. The possibilities are... rather limited, actually. But there's a decent amount of stuff.Gene Splicers
Spoiler
Find Gene Splicers out in the fringes, which let you move skills between officers. Some even come pre-filled!
... but be careful, don't just do any drugs you find lying around. Not all the skills they have are good!Giant Alien Spiders
Spoiler
Giant alien spiders are no joke! Fortunately, your marines are professionals and have no time for jokes.Just what would happen if you kept this egg around?Strange Canisters
Spoiler
Might want the PPE on for this one.Other varying self-contained encounters as small setpieces






... and more!

Fishing

Spoiler
Adds a fishing minigame with associated systems. You can learn to fish at Fikenhild.
Look at your fishing catalogue to plan your excursion, fish the fish, and cook them into one of many unique meals with custom effects.
Or maybe you just want to watch them swim around in your fish tank at the end of a long day?

Ships

Spoiler
Archipelago
Spoiler
Some advertisement drone that exists as one of the only remnants of a corporation that fell apart after the Collapse.Rumored to be spotted in the fringes nearby water worlds.
Can operate unmanned, but comes with onboard vomit buckets in the event it's piloted by a captain. Hold on tight!Houndslaught
Spoiler
Fourty hounds strong with a nasty bite. Able to disperse its Hound modules like a swarm of bats to reposition as needed.
Comes with an Alex-approved Alviss version.Fenrir
Spoiler
Too many hounds? I understand. Here's something more reasonable.Ziggurat Mk.I
Spoiler
Horrific love child of an onslaught and a certain phase ship. Maybe you can get it by talking to a certain Company director while its parents are in your fleet? Longquest
Spoiler
Who needs engines with arms like these? Note: may require assembly... and more

Quests

Spoiler
Go cave diving to reunite a mechanic with her friend.
Help a Luddic Path engineer experiment on AI, and maybe cause more trouble for the sector in the process.
Give your friend moral support as they arm wrestle the pirate queen.
... and more!

Secrets of the Frontier: Boss fight

Spoiler
Adds the Radiance from Hollow Knight as a boss you can fight using Sierra.You can unlock the main menu version of the fight after doing the associated quest in the campaign.

Second-in-Command: BUFFMEAT Aptitude

Spoiler
Adds the BUFFMEAT aptitude for a recruitable character in the mod.Highly benefits crewed low tech ships, especially those that fight at close range.

Nexerlin: New custom start, background

Spoiler
Assimilation Custom Start
Spoiler
Start the game under Remnant commission as an AI fleet commander. You will have access to any Remnant nexus as a dock and can use them to print new ships.You can teach new automated ships to the Remnants by feeding them to a Nexus.Intended for an AI fleet roleplaying playthrough. You will be locked to hostile with most factions.Trash Man Background
Spoiler
Gives all your ships red barcodes.

Miscellanous Features

Spoiler
Anything I thought was interesting enough to put on the forum post and doesn't spoil something, but isn't directly related to any other features.
Experimental-C
Spoiler
Lunalib toggle that allows you to use hullmods which do more experimental things. Rip a ship system out of one ship and put it in another, give a ship a makeshift phase cloak or even shunt the phase out of an existing phase ship so you can give it a shield.


Stelnet Community
Spoiler
Curious about the current happenings in the Sector? Doomscroll through the Stelnet Community page!
Currently WIP but has ~40 written posts, some triggered by doing specific things (using a gate in a colonized system, winning the duel in Princess of Persia, etc) or enabling specific mods (Tahlan Shipworks, Secrets of the Frontier, Volkov Industrial Conglomerate, etc).

If these previews fail to convince you, please view this collection of curated user reviews.

Spoiler

FAQ

Can it be added to existing saves?

Yes. Some things may behave strangely if added very late into a playthrough, but nothing game breaking.

How do I engage with the content?

Just do whatever you normally do. There's no central faction or big feature of the mod that demands attention... but if you don't like that answer, explore the fringes, check bars, maybe stop by Fikenhild?

There's also a mod guide attached that has steps on how to find (almost) everything, if you don't care for spoilers.

Is this mod balanced?

Not at all!

Unserious? How bad is it?

Yes. Basically the Wild Wasteland of starsector. This is firmly a meme mod. If you value immersion, don't install this.

Is this mod finished?

No. The current features are relatively complete, although you might run into missing dialog here and there. It'll work on it as I can.

Stability?

The mod shouldn't cause notable lag, I run a profiler on everything. Crashes should be fairly unlikely, but I may have missed some cross-mod wonk.

TriOS says the mod uses 8 billion megabytes of VRAM!

Yeah. The mod loads and unloads sprites as needed, so the actual usage won't be as high. A specific boss fight listed above is responsible for this. if you're skirting your VRAM limit as is you may be unable to fight that boss.

Typical vram usage for the mod is ~200 megabytes

RECENT CHANGELOG

For full changelog, see attached changelog.txt with the mod

Spoiler
Version 0.5.511

Fixed listener crash when interacting with nothing

Version 0.5.51

Fixed a few crashes that would happen on Linux

Version 0.5.5

Save compatible, but updating in an existing save may cause some non-important dialog to display incorrectly.

Added a new flavor feature you can mess around with. Added a related bar event that introduces you to it.
It's unfinished at the moment, as in there's not a lot to interact with. I will add more to it as time goes on.

Added a new type of AI core that appears during the Forever War mini-quest

Longquest is now easier to find
   - finding one of its arms automatically gives you the location of the wreck if you haven't recovered it yet (new save only)
   - wreck can be detected further away (new save only)
   - dialog modified to make it more obvious of where

saveCompatibilityText:
Can it be added to existing saves?
Yes. Some things may behave strangely if added very late into a playthrough, but nothing game breaking.

changelog.0.5.5111: Fixed listener crash when interacting with nothing
changelog.0.5.51: Fixed a few crashes that would happen on Linux
changelog.0.5.5:
Save compatible, but updating in an existing save may cause some non-important dialog to display incorrectly.

Added a new flavor feature you can mess around with. Added a related bar event that introduces you to it.
It's unfinished at the moment, as in there's not a lot to interact with. I will add more to it as time goes on.

Added a new type of AI core that appears during the Forever War mini-quest

Longquest is now easier to find
   - finding one of its arms automatically gives you the location of the wreck if you haven't recovered it yet (new save only)
   - wreck can be detected further away (new save only)
   - dialog modified to make it more obvious of where it could appear

Locus is now easier to find
   - wreck can be detected further away and emits a large gold sensor ping (new save only)
In the future it may be part of a quest/background, not sure for now

Locus' unique gauge now builds faster and scales harder off of investment
   - formula changed to always have a base 5 energy generation, then adds on gain from flux
   - flux per extra energy point reduced (350 -> 300)
   - max generation per use increased (25 -> 34)
effectively you'll build pangenesis uses faster and scale much harder off of high investment into caps
for the max bonus you will need skills + hullmods (such as flux coil + technology skills)
should feel suitably super now and less like herding cats ALL the time, although you will still need to do so to get your freaky mode

"Well Fed" can no longer be removed by gene splicers

Reduced chaining on Longquest zapper weapon to 8 max jumps (it was 20 jumps before, insane modslop)

Updated mod guide with some missing stuff

Probably fixed explosion immunity not working on sanctified cores when under very high timeflow and speed
Fixed crossmod crash related to generating alien spider campaign interaction
